source: Minchat Shai on Gen 38:3 (the Masorah; the Toledo-corrected books; Ramban)

A book-variance (some copies read va-tiqra here too) is filed named; the Toledo-corrected books and Onkelos hold the he-form.

source: Bereshit Rabbah 85:9 (ledger gen_61 row 4, reading pass 2026-08-28)
middah: E27 (symmetry)
claim_en: THE KID FOR THE KID. The kid-of-goats ‹גְּדִי עִזִּים› ("gedi izzim") stands in Genesis at exactly four places, in two matched pairs: 27:9 and 27:16, where Jacob is dressed in kid-skins to deceive his blind father, and 38:17 and 38:20, where Judah's pledged kid is what Tamar turns against him. The reading draws the repayment — the deception worked with a kid is undone by a kid one generation on — and the same word carries the Torah's thrice-repeated prohibition on boiling a kid in its mother's milk (Exod 23:19, 34:26, Deut 14:21).

source: Bereshit Rabbah 85:5 (ledger gen_61 row 2, reading pass 2026-08-28)
middah: plain (Judah the first levir; the permitted-prohibited-permitted rule quoted whole)
claim_en: THE LEVIRATE INSTITUTION'S BIRTH-SEAT: Judah is read as the FIRST to perform the levirate obligation, before it was commanded at Deuteronomy 25:5. The reading carries with it a formal rule of legal state, quoted whole: what was permitted, then prohibited, then permitted again returns NOT to its first permission but to a SECOND — so 'her husband's brother shall consort with her' is a mitzva and not merely a licence. A rule about how permissions reset, arriving inside a narrative span and owed to the law spans that will test it.

Witness-tier: the objects are ordinary security in the grammar and dynastic instruments in the reading; the machine holds the second sense at witness tier only.

source: Bereshit Rabbah 85:12 (ledger gen_61 row 5) with Onkelos Genesis 38:26
middah: plain (the Voice as the court's witness; the translation splitting the word two ways; dual-track)
claim_en: THE VOICE AS THE COURT'S MISSING WITNESS: at 'she is more righteous than I' the reading hears a Divine Voice supplying the testimony no human witness could give — 'you attest what is revealed; I attest what is concealed' — and counts three courts where the Voice so testified (Shem's here, Samuel's, Solomon's). The received translation splits the same word two ways, rendering the clause as a verdict about her plus a separate admission of paternity, so the confession and the fatherhood are carried as two acts, not one. Dual-track, not decided.
